title: Test SauceDemo login and shopping cart
body:
Target application: https://www.saucedemo.com/

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Valid login:
   - Username: standard_user
   - Password: secret_sauce
   - Verify that the Products page is displayed.
2. Invalid login:
   - Username: invalid_user
   - Password: wrong_password
   - Verify that this exact error message is displayed: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service
3. Add product to cart:
   - Log in using valid credentials.
   - Add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart.
   - Verify that the cart count becomes 1.
4. Cart display:
   - Log in using valid credentials in an independent browser session.
   - Add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart.
   - Open the cart.
   - Verify that Sauce Labs Backpack is displayed.
5. Problem user - Add to cart regression:
   - Username: problem_user
   - Password: secret_sauce
   - Log in using the supplied credentials.
   - Locate Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt and click its associated Add to cart button.
   - Verify that the button label changes to Remove.
   - Report a failed scenario only when the action completes but Remove is not visible.

Planning requirements:
- Generate one separate scenario for each numbered acceptance criterion, in the same order.
- Each scenario must run in a fresh browser context and include its own login/setup actions.
- Never omit the invalid-login criterion or the problem-user regression criterion.
- Never treat API, browser, locator, or network errors as application defects.
